connectionConfigSchema.title: ITERABLE_AUDIENCE rETL connection config
connectionConfigSchema.description: Per-connection destination config for a VDM v2 rETL connection, as accepted in `destinationConfig` on POST /v2/retl-connections. Mirrors IterableConnectionConfigSchema in rudder-transformer (src/v0/destinations/iterable_audience/types.ts), minus identifierMappings, which config-backend writes from the request's `identifiers`. This destination declares no audienceId in its own configSchema, so the connection is the only place it lives.

audienceId.description: The Iterable list this connection delivers to. A string is accepted because the dashboard stores the id as one, but it must spell a positive integer: the transformer does `Number(audienceId)` (routerTransform.ts:123, commented "Iterable's API expects a numeric listId"), so "" becomes 0 and "abc" becomes NaN, which serialises to `listId: null` and fails at sync time instead of at create time.

updateExistingUsersOnly.description: Forwarded into the Iterable subscribe request. Iterable defaults to false when omitted, and it is only respected for userID-based and hybrid projects.
